use.flag: Route ALSA playback to PipeWire (requires media-video/pipewire with USE=pipewire-alsa)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: DeckCraft is a clean-room reimplementation of a PowerPoint-style presentation application in pure Rust: create and present slide decks. Installed from the upstream Linux tarball; the binary only links against glibc and loads the graphics libraries at runtime. Early alpha.
